decision_rule.text: For source-only and complete own rows, cancel auxiliary AND target columns. Total Delta=rank([[M,0],[B,U]])-rank(U)-rank(M). K consists of own non-collected source units/anchors and accepted formal definition rows plus target Registry pure-P base matches; K contribution is separately cancelled Delta(M,K), and collected increment is Delta(M,K+B)-Delta(M,K). Source/full K differ only by actually available own target P labels; target marginal is complete minus source Delta. Direct gain uses U=0 rows; cross gain is corrected Delta minus direct gain. Known16 labels are supplied information. Report positive/zero/adverse outcomes and all costs; do not infer a weighted winner. Accepted formal definitions alone must have identity auxiliary block/zero old-base Delta. Actual own public coincidences remain K and need not have zero Delta. A separate signed expanded-old coefficient/public-point/dense semantic oracle must agree with native target unit membership and cancelled old-base ranks; preserve repeated coefficients and cancellations. This oracle is checker work, not another producer target solver.
decision_rule.threshold: No favorable outcome required; exact completion/controls only. Incomplete costs and unsigned producer assertions do not establish complete attack or trusted execution standing.
